comparison.objective: Remove a heatsink without pulling the processor from its socket; candidate removes a terminal without damaging its connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Release heatsink retention and separate a large stuck thermal interface while countering processor pullout versus fine blade-under-tab insertion and coupled wire/tool withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Heatsink placed on mat while processor remains seated; candidate terminal exits while housing, crimp and neighboring terminals remain intact. Candidate lacks exact force/damage thresholds.
comparison.reason: Both test selective extraction with a retained neighbor, but their release mechanisms and force-control abilities are materially different.
